# CS Fundamentals

> An in-depth, visual introduction to computer science. Every topic derives
> its complexity bounds rather than asserting them, and covers when NOT to
> use a structure or technique and how it fails.

Site: https://danielsousaoliveira.github.io/cs-fundamentals/
Source: https://github.com/danielsousaoliveira/cs-fundamentals

## Sections

- Complexity
- Data Structures
- Algorithms
- Paradigms
- Systems
- Languages
- Data Engineering
- Databases & Storage
- Cloud & Infra
- AI Engineering
- Web & Frontend
- Backend & APIs
- Architecture
- Production

Every complete page follows the same spine: intuition, a visual, the
mechanics, complexity or cost derived from the mechanics, when not to use it,
real-world usage, failure modes, practice problems, and interview answers.
